facts.minimum: Android 7 (API 24), a hardware H.264 decoder; HEVC for 4K
facts.notes: Applies to every Android TV. Brand profiles add to it.

quirks.symptom: receiver says 'decoder busy'; other video apps also fail
quirks.cause: TVs often have a single hardware decoder; something else (live TV, a vendor service) holds it
quirks.check: adb shell dumpsys media.player | head -50; adb shell dumpsys activity activities | grep mResumedActivity
quirks.fix: close the app holding it; see the brand profile for middleware that keeps it

quirks.cause: the UI layer is 1080p on many TVs; only the video plane is 4K
quirks.fix: none needed: the receiver renders on a SurfaceView fixed at the stream size

quirks.symptom: the receiver's log lines are missing from logcat
quirks.fix: read the receiver's debug file instead

quirks.symptom: adb screencap -p output truncated or black
quirks.cause: slow TVs; the video plane is not always in screenshots
quirks.fix: use the raw format and convert on the computer; retry for the video plane

quirks.symptom: the stock home app jumps to the front during adb install
quirks.cause: vendor launchers relaunch after package changes
quirks.check: adb shell dumpsys activity activities | grep mResumedActivity (before installing)
quirks.fix: install only when nobody is watching; ask first

quirks.symptom: am start brings the receiver forward but the extras (app, play) do nothing
quirks.cause: without NEW_TASK|CLEAR_TOP the existing task is only brought forward
quirks.check: the am start output says 'its current task has been brought to the front'

quirks.symptom: adb connect: No route to host, from the Mac
quirks.cause: macOS Local Network privacy blocks the terminal
quirks.check: System Settings → Privacy & Security → Local Network
